model_annotation: The image displays three separate pie charts side by side, each illustrating proportional distributions of different categories. The leftmost chart, titled "Categorical," is divided into four segments: "Negation" (27.91%, orange), "Universal Quantifiers" (29.07%, light blue), "Limiter" (27.91%, light pink), and a smaller segment labeled "Existential Quantifiers" (approximately 5.03%, light green), which is partially obscured by a gray rectangle overlay. The middle chart, "Approximate Number Generation," contains three segments: "Approximate Quantities" (45.03%, beige), "Comparative Relationships" (36.26%, light blue), and "Absolute Absence" (18.71%, light purple). The rightmost chart, "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," is split into two nearly equal parts: "Disjunctive" (49.51%, light blue) and "Conjunctive" (50.49%, light pink). Each pie chart includes percentage labels directly within its respective slices and does not use a separate legend; the slices are arranged in descending order of size within each chart.
